---
title: Pasta con le Sarde (Sicilian-Style Pasta with Sardines)
id: MAR-0090
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g bucatini
- 350 g sardines
- 30 g seedless dried raisins
- 50 g breadcrumbs
- 30 g toasted pine nuts
- 350 g wild fennel
- 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 4 anchovy fillets
- 1 saffron
- 1 onion
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Toast the breadcrumbs in a pan without adding fat.
2. Soak the raisins in warm water for 20 minutes.
3. Clean the fennel, put it in a pot with plenty of salted water and boil for 20 minutes, then drain, squeeze and chop it.
4. Clean the sardines, fillet them and cut into large pieces.
5. Chop the anchovies.
6. Peel the onion, dice it and sauté in a large pan with the oil.
7. Dissolve the anchovies in it, then add the saffron dissolved in a little water, the fennel, the squeezed raisins and the pine nuts, salt lightly, mix and cook for 6-7 minutes.
8. Add the sardines and cook for 2-3 minutes.
9. Cook the pasta in the boiling fennel cooking water, drain it, combine with the sardines and breadcrumbs, mix and serve.
